name: Froxel Fog with Temporal Reprojection and Revealed Froxel Blur
definition: Froxel fog renders volumetric fog by cutting the view frustum into a grid of cells (screen tiles across, depth slices deep). Each cell stores medium density and sunlight shadow factor. A front-to-back march computes in-scattered light and transmittance.
summary: This method reduces noise in froxel-based volumetric fog by increasing sampling and applying a targeted blur pass only to shadow factors of froxels revealed when temporal reprojection fails.
